image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on green vegetation. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying a uniform dark brown color with faint, small eyespots (ocelli) along the margins. The body is fuzzy and brown, matching the wings. One antenna is clearly visible with a clubbed tip. Several legs are visible gripping the plant stem.

The connection points where the legs grip the green stem are somewhat indistinct. The legs appear to merge slightly with the stem rather than wrapping around it with clear occlusion boundaries.
